summary: Approximately 56,785 km² and about 7.8 million people (2017), from Wikidata's Q945 (P2046, P1082). The English Wikipedia article "Togo", at revision 1376059890, opens: "Togo, officially the Togolese Republic, is a country located in West Africa. It is bordered by Ghana to the west, Benin to the east and Burkina Faso to the north. It is one of the least developed countries in the world." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Entity 461 in the Gleditsch–Ward state list, as mapped by CShapes 2.0, a dataset of the borders and capitals of states and dependencies between 1886 and 2019. The dataset gives it 1 period of territorial validity, from 1960 to where the dataset stops, in 2019. Its last capital in the dataset is Lome. The code is mapped onto more than one actor (data/imports/cshapes-actors.json); this record holds the periods from 1960-04-27. This record was written by the import from those fields and asserts nothing the dataset does not.
